name: Baseline
description: Ordinary synthetic random demand with no forced intervention.
limitations: Synthetic and uncalibrated; not observed traffic demand.

name: High demand
description: Doubles the synthetic departure rate while retaining baseline vehicle behaviour.
limitations: High is a demonstrative label, not a calibrated traffic condition.

name: Lead-vehicle emergency braking
description: A deterministic lead/follower pair receives a one-second emergency-deceleration command after a validated preparation pass.
limitations: The intervention and response are simulated, not observations of real drivers.
SUMO safety checks remain enabled, so measured acceleration may differ from the command.

name: Reduced reaction margin
description: Reduces the desired following time gap while keeping demand and other vehicle parameters controlled.
limitations: Tau is a behavioural assumption and is not calibrated to observed drivers.
